user_definition_of_urm: URM are anyone who is not white, asian or international.
international_operational_category: IPEDS GRNRALT, U.S. nonresident; exact benchmark agreement is checked rather than assuming it covers all foreign-born students.
unknown_status: User explicitly chose to leave the race/ethnicity-unknown placement unresolved on 2026-10-16. Do not infer a grouping from benchmark agreement.
source_policy: User-supplied CSVs are immutable expected results. Dataset differences are retained as failures, not used to change expectations.
coverage: IPEDS observation years 2015 through 2024. Six-year graduation cohorts enter six years before observation year.

sat_definition_verification.population: Enrolled first-time degree/certificate-seeking undergraduates submitting relevant SAT scores, including prior-summer entrants. Broad population aligns with Yale College first-year students.
sat_definition_verification.score_protocol: New 2016 SAT scale and old-to-new concordance required by 2017/2018 instructions; scores used in admission decision. Yale CSV footnote/score selection not supplied.
sat_definition_verification.comparability: Population aligned; exact scoring/reporting basis unresolved. Five numeric mismatches retained.
